subject.title: feat(ui): add configurable chat send shortcut

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference be accepted as a scoped Control UI setting for this PR?
rationale: The linked issue originally floated openclaw.json or another configuration path, while this PR adds a new persisted UiSettings field; maintainer intent should confirm the product surface before the setting becomes a user contract.

options.title: Approve Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Land the preference as a gateway-scoped Control UI setting with default Enter-to-send and no gateway/openclaw.json config surface.

options.title: Require Gateway Config
options.body: Ask for an operator-visible gateway config/default instead, accepting the larger docs and compatibility burden.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this PR until settings ownership is resolved elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Land the preference as a gateway-scoped Control UI setting with default Enter-to-send and no gateway/openclaw.json config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this replay and are tied to the relevant current-main chat behavior and prior maintainer review context.
